sources.title: NASA: Artemis III candidate landing regions (2024-10-28)

caveats: Feature centres from the IAU Gazetteer, not NASA landing-region polygons.
LDEM_16 native pixels are ~1.9 km north-south; a 24 km footprint is regional relief only.
Earth terrain twins compare relief shape (F) only; Earth cannot reproduce polar illumination, permanently shadowed cold traps, vacuum, 1.62 m/s² gravity or lunar regolith.

terrain.resampling: bilinear interpolation of validated native pixel-center height values to a 7x7, 4-km local-offset grid; no additional filtering
terrain.measurement_scale: broad regional terrain only, approximately 24x24 km center-to-center footprint; sample lattice is not native pixel resolution
